intro.en: UI Management develops business analysis and decision-making across finance, marketing, people and operations.
intro.id: Manajemen UI mengembangkan kemampuan analisis bisnis dan pengambilan keputusan dalam keuangan, pemasaran, SDM, dan operasi.

careers.en: Possible fields include finance, marketing, HR, operations and management consulting.
careers.id: Bidang karier dapat meliputi keuangan, pemasaran, SDM, operasi, dan konsultasi manajemen.

cohortNote.en: 145 SKS and the eight-semester plan follow the 2023 handbook. An older summary states 144 SKS; a new intake follows its own curriculum.
cohortNote.id: 145 SKS dan rencana delapan semester mengikuti pedoman 2023. Ringkasan lama masih menyebut 144 SKS; angkatan baru mengikuti kurikulumnya sendiri.

intro.en: UGM's regular Management programme combines business theory, case studies and practical decision-making.
intro.id: Manajemen reguler UGM memadukan teori bisnis, studi kasus, dan praktik pengambilan keputusan.

careers.en: Official career examples include banking, consulting, marketing and business development.
careers.id: Contoh karier resmi meliputi perbankan, konsultasi, pemasaran, dan pengembangan bisnis.

cohortNote.en: The September 2026 curriculum lists 144 credits over semesters 1–7; earlier cohorts follow their applicable curriculum.
cohortNote.id: Kurikulum September 2026 memuat 144 SKS pada semester 1–7; angkatan terdahulu mengikuti kurikulum yang berlaku baginya.

intro.en: UNY's 2025 Management curriculum combines business foundations, digital skills, industry practice and entrepreneurship.
intro.id: Kurikulum Manajemen UNY 2025 memadukan fondasi bisnis, keterampilan digital, praktik industri, dan kewirausahaan.

careers.en: The programme identifies management, entrepreneurship and management research as graduate directions.
careers.id: Program menetapkan manajemen, kewirausahaan, dan penelitian manajemen sebagai arah lulusan.

cohortNote.en: The published document gives conflicting 145/146-credit totals; confirm the applicable requirement with the programme.
cohortNote.id: Dokumen terbitan mencantumkan total 145/146 SKS yang tidak konsisten; pastikan ketentuan angkatan melalui program studi.

intro.en: The published MKS curriculum connects Islamic financial principles with accounting, investment and risk management.
intro.id: Kurikulum MKS yang dipublikasikan menghubungkan prinsip keuangan Islam dengan akuntansi, investasi, dan pengelolaan risiko.

cohortNote.en: This undated list verifies course examples. Current cohort credit totals, award and normal duration are not confirmed.
cohortNote.id: Daftar tanpa tahun ini memverifikasi contoh mata kuliah. Total SKS, gelar, dan masa studi normal angkatan berjalan belum terkonfirmasi.

intro.en: Study business analysis, strategic decisions and resource management, with five published specialisation options.
intro.id: Pelajari analisis bisnis, keputusan strategis, dan pengelolaan sumber daya melalui lima pilihan peminatan yang dipublikasikan.

careers.en: Published graduate directions include management analyst, first-line manager and entrepreneur.
careers.id: Arah lulusan yang disebutkan: analis manajemen, manajer tingkat pertama, dan wirausahawan.

cohortNote.en: Current faculty profile lists 145 SKS; confirm the curriculum applicable to your intake.
cohortNote.id: Profil fakultas saat diperiksa mencantumkan 145 SKS; pastikan kurikulum yang berlaku bagi angkatanmu.

sources.covers: Award, 8 semesters, 145 SKS, specialisations, listed courses, graduate directions; teaching language not stated.

intro.en: Combine management foundations with business practice, decision-making and technology through ITB’s 2024 curriculum.
intro.id: Gabungkan dasar manajemen dengan praktik bisnis, pengambilan keputusan, dan teknologi melalui Kurikulum 2024 ITB.

careers.en: SBM describes preparation for entrepreneurship and work in companies, government or nonprofit organisations.
careers.id: SBM menyebut persiapan berwirausaha serta bekerja di perusahaan, pemerintah, atau organisasi nirlaba.

cohortNote.en: Central ITB lists 8 semesters; SBM’s separate page retains an older 3-year/9-short-semester structure. Use the central profile and 2024 curriculum.
cohortNote.id: ITB pusat mencantumkan 8 semester; halaman SBM lain masih memuat struktur lama 3 tahun/9  semester pendek. Gunakan profil pusat dan Kurikulum 2024.

intro.en: Explore programming, AI, multimedia and computer networks through theoretical study and practical projects.
intro.id: Pelajari pemrograman, AI, multimedia, dan jaringan komputer melalui teori serta proyek praktik.

careers.en: The programme presents pathways toward AI/software engineering, content creation and digital freelance work.
careers.id: Prodi mengenalkan jalur AI/software engineer, content creator, dan digital freelancer.

cohortNote.en: Courses checked against the 2025 handbook. The page also displays 2021 curricula for older cohorts; current graduation credits and duration were not confirmed.
cohortNote.id: Mata kuliah diperiksa pada buku 2025. Halaman juga memuat kurikulum 2021 bagi angkatan lama; jumlah SKS kelulusan dan durasi terkini belum terkonfirmasi.
